# Requirements: Minimalist Blog Website

## Source

Confluence page: [Requirements: Blog Website Application](https://vikram-epam-practice.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ghcc/pages/24477697/Requirements+Blog+Website+Application)

Retrieved: 2026-10-26

## Project overview

Build a minimalist blog application where visitors can register and log in, browse/search/sort published posts, and authenticated users can create posts and manage their own posts. The application must enforce author ownership and secure account/session behavior.

## Functional requirements

### Authentication and sessions

**US-101 — Register**
- Provide registration fields for username, email, and password.
- Validate required fields and enforce a minimum password length on the client.
- Detect duplicate usernames or email addresses and show a conflict error.
- On successful registration, redirect to Login.

**US-102 — Log in**
- Provide username-or-email and password fields.
- On valid credentials, authenticate the user and redirect to Home.
- On invalid credentials, display an appropriate error.

**US-103 — Persist session, time out, and log out**
- Keep the authenticated session across refreshes and new tabs.
- Provide a visible Logout action that ends the session and redirects to Login.
- Expire the session after 30 minutes of inactivity and require re-authentication.

### Browse, search, and sort

**US-201 — Home feed**
- Show a chronological feed of posts from all users.
- Each post item includes its title, author name, published/modified date, and a content preview.
- Selecting a post opens its full reading view.

**US-202 — Search**
- Provide a search input on Home.
- Filter posts by keyword in title or content, either as the user types or on submission.
- Show “No blogs found” when there are no matches.

**US-203 — Sort**
- Provide sorting by title ascending (A–Z) or descending (Z–A), and by modified date newest-first or oldest-first.
- Apply the selected ordering immediately.

### Post management and authorization

**US-301 — Create**
- Make the Create Blog option available only to authenticated users.
- Provide title and content fields.
- Save the post with the authenticated user as its author and redirect appropriately.

**US-302 — Edit**
- Show Edit only to the original author.
- Prepopulate the edit form with the post’s current title and content.
- Save changes and update the modified timestamp.
- Block attempts by other users to edit the post (403 Forbidden or redirection).

**US-303 — Delete**
- Show Delete only to the original author.
- Require confirmation before deletion.
- On confirmation, remove the post from storage and update the feed.
- Block attempts by other users to delete the post.

## Non-functional requirements and constraints

- Keep the interface clean and minimalist.
- Enforce server-side or equivalent trusted authorization so authors can modify or delete only their own posts.
- Handle passwords securely.
- Enforce the 30-minute inactivity timeout.
- Do not include image uploads, email OTP password resets, or rich WYSIWYG editing.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Registration validates required values and password length, rejects duplicate username/email, and redirects on success.
- [ ] Login accepts username or email, handles invalid credentials, and redirects on success.
- [ ] Sessions survive refreshes/new tabs, expire after 30 minutes of inactivity, and end on logout.
- [ ] Home displays all posts in chronological order with the specified metadata and content preview.
- [ ] Selecting a post opens its full content.
- [ ] Search matches post title and content and presents the specified empty state.
- [ ] All four sort modes reorder the feed immediately.
- [ ] Only authenticated users can create posts; the authenticated user is stored as author.
- [ ] Only the original author can edit or delete; edits update modified time and deletion is confirmed.
- [ ] Unauthorized edit/delete attempts are blocked even when initiated outside the visible UI controls.
- [ ] Excluded features remain out of scope.

## Open details not specified by the source

- The minimum password length and detailed password policy are unspecified.
- Whether username/email matching is case-sensitive is unspecified.
- The exact post preview length, timestamp display format, and tie-breaking order are unspecified.
- The source allows search filtering in real time or on submission; the interaction mode is not fixed.
- Registration/login rate limiting, session storage mechanism, and persistence backend are unspecified.
- The exact successful create/edit/delete destinations are unspecified beyond updating the feed or redirecting appropriately.
